en.name: Photriya
en.subtitle: Capture & imagine colours
en.short_description: Capture colors with your camera, build palettes and edit photos.
en.description:
Photriya — color capture and creative photo tools for photographers and designers.

CAPTURE & ANALYZE
Point your camera at anything and read the color at the center of the frame in real time: HEX, RGB, HSL and CMYK values, color temperature, luminance and a descriptive color name. Switch to Palette, Harmony or Gradient mode to see tints and shades, complementary, analogous and triadic colors, or a gradient built from the live color.

LIBRARY, HISTORY & PALETTES
Save captures, mark favorites and build palettes. The palette builder generates complementary, analogous, triadic and split-complementary harmonies and copies a palette as HEX, CSS or ASE text.

CREATIVE TOOLS
• Color Grading — adjust exposure, contrast, saturation, temperature and tint, or apply a preset, then save the graded photo to your library
• Collage Builder — place your photos into a layout and save the collage
• Frames & Borders — frame a photo and save it
• Watermark Studio — add a text or logo watermark and save the result

PRO TOOLS
• Histogram and EXIF viewer for your photos
• Shot Planner — sunrise, sunset, golden hour and blue hour for your location or any coordinates you enter

AI PLAYGROUND — BRING YOUR OWN OPENAI KEY
Describe an image and generate it with DALL·E in one of 9 styles, or analyze a photo's palette, mood and lighting with GPT-4o. AI features need your own OpenAI API key, added in Settings. Requests go from your device directly to OpenAI and are billed to your OpenAI account.

LEARN
Written lessons, quizzes and articles on color and photography.

PRIVACY
Captures and palettes are stored on your device. Photos you edit stay on your device; a photo is sent to OpenAI only when you ask the AI to analyze it. An account is optional.

ADS
Photriya shows ads from Google AdMob. Google may use device identifiers to serve and measure ads. The app does not track you across other companies' apps or websites; where the law requires it (for example in the EEA and UK) ads are requested only after you give consent, and you can change that choice in Settings > Privacy choices.

AI DISCLOSURE
AI-generated images and analyses come from OpenAI models and may not accurately represent real-world colors or scenes.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
Photriya — color capture and creative photo tools for photographers and designers.

Intended audience:
Capture & imagine colours

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
The app opens on a sign-in screen. An account is optional; the main features can be reached without signing in.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Firebase (Google) — app initialisation
- Firebase Authentication (Google) — sign-in
- Supabase — account and data storage
- Google Sign-In — authentication
- Sign in with Apple — authentication
- Apple In-App Purchase — paid features
- device location services (on-device)
- HTTPS requests to the app's own endpoints
- Google AdMob (ads) — banner and interstitial ads; consent via Google's User Messaging Platform where required; no App Tracking Transparency prompt (non-tracking)

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app follows the device language for 12 locales (Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish), but translation is partial: shared labels are translated, while most screen text is in English only. Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
Account deletion is available in the app under Settings, and on the support site.
